mapper.sql: from wms_inventory inventory inner join wms_item_sku sku on inventory.sku_id = sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id left join wms_warehouse warehouse on inventory.warehouse_id = warehouse.id left join wms_area area on inventory.area_id = area.id
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(case when inventory.quantity > 0 then inventory.quantity else 0 end), 0) as currentQuantity, ifnull(sum(case when inventory.quantity > 0 then inventory.quantity else 0 end), 0) as availableQuantity, count(distinct case when inventory.quantity > 0 then inventory.warehouse_id end) as warehouseCount, count(distinct case when inventory.quantity > 0 then inventory.area_id end) as areaCount, sum(case when inventory.quantity < 0 then 1 else 0 end) as abnormalCount

select coalesce(area.area_name, warehouse.warehouse_name, '未分配') as label, ifnull(sum(case when inventory.quantity > 0 then inventory.quantity else 0 end), 0) as quantity
group by coalesce(area.area_name, warehouse.warehouse_name, '未分配') having quantity > 0 order by quantity desc, label asc limit 6

select inventory.id, warehouse.warehouse_name as warehouseName, area.area_name as areaName, item.item_name as itemName, sku.sku_name as skuName, item.item_code as itemCode, sku.product_identifier as productIdentifier, sku.quality_grade as qualityGrade, inventory.quantity, inventory.update_time as updateTime
inventory.quantity > 0
and inventory.warehouse_id = #{bo.warehouseId}
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and item.equipment_type = #{bo.equipmentType}
and sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
order by inventory.update_time desc, inventory.id desc
